basis: The statement captures the full statutory definition of an IEP under section 1414(d)(1)(A)(i) along with all its internal conditions and components.
The text accurately and fully represents the rule of construction in section 1414(d)(1)(A)(ii)(I).
The statement accurately captures the non-duplication rule of construction under section 1414(d)(1)(A)(ii)(II).
The statement provides the complete statutory definition and membership composition of an IEP Team under section 1414(d)(1)(B).
The statement captures the complete rule and governing conditions for attendance excusal when a member's area is not modified or discussed.
The statement preserves all statutory conditions and prerequisites for excusing an IEP Team member when their area is discussed or modified.
The statement relies on unresolved relative cross-references 'clause (i)' and 'clause (ii)' without specifying the agreements/consents to which they apply (IEP team attendance and excusal).
The statement preserves the full statutory requirement, condition, and purpose regarding invitations to subchapter III personnel for the initial IEP meeting.
